```{r}
# shared theme for all figures
theme_urchin <- function(base_size = 13, angle_x = 0) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.border       = element_blank(),
      axis.line          = element_line(colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks         = element_line(colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x        = element_markdown(angle = angle_x,          # <-- changed from element_text
                                             hjust = if (angle_x == 0) 0.5 else 1),
      plot.title         = element_text(size = base_size + 1, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      strip.background   = element_blank(),
      strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(0.85)),
      legend.position     = "bottom",
      legend.title        = element_text(size = rel(0.85)),
      legend.text         = element_markdown(size = rel(0.85)),
      axis.title.y        = element_text(size = rel(0.85), margin = margin(r = 4)),
      panel.spacing.x     = unit(1, "lines")
    )
}

hab_fill <- function(name = NULL) {
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = c("Macrocystis Forest", "Urchin Barren"),
    values = c("Macrocystis Forest" = "#00BFC4", "Urchin Barren" = "#F8766D"),
    labels = c("Macrocystis Forest" = "*Macrocystis* Forest",
               "Urchin Barren"      = "Urchin Barren"),
    name   = name
  )
}

hab_cols <- c("Barren" = "#F8766D", "Macro_Forest" = "#00BFC4")
hab_labs <- c("Barren" = "Urchin Barren", "Macro_Forest" = "*Macrocystis* Forest")
```

### Redoing model will full 5 days

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

tide_file <- "/Users/aminashenasa/soundscapes_data/data/environmental_data/noaa_july_tides_2025.txt"
file.exists(tide_file)   # should print TRUE

tide_all <- read_lines(tide_file) |>
  keep(~ grepl("^\\d{4}/\\d{2}/\\d{2}", .x)) |>
  I() |>
  read_table(
    col_names = c("date", "day", "time", "ampm", "amplitude"),
    col_types = "ccccd"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    datetime = as.POSIXct(paste(date, time, ampm),
                          format = "%Y/%m/%d %I:%M %p",
                          tz = "America/Sitka")
  ) |>
  select(datetime, amplitude)

head(tide_all)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)

SITE_TZ    <- "America/Sitka"
PLOT_DATES <- as.Date(c("2025-07-23", "2025-07-24", "2025-07-25",
                        "2025-07-26", "2025-07-27", "2025-07-28"))

# --- Tide table: full local days, hourly, from the new NOAA file ---
tide_file <- "/Users/aminashenasa/soundscapes_data/data/environmental_data/noaa_july_tides_2025.txt"

tide_all <- read_lines(tide_file) |>
  keep(~ grepl("^\\d{4}/\\d{2}/\\d{2}", .x)) |>
  I() |>
  read_table(col_names = c("date", "day", "time", "ampm", "amplitude"),
             col_types = "ccccd") |>
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct(paste(date, time, ampm),
                               format = "%Y/%m/%d %I:%M %p",
                               tz = SITE_TZ)) |>
  select(datetime, amplitude)

noaa_tide <- tide_all |>
  filter(as.Date(datetime, tz = SITE_TZ) %in% PLOT_DATES,
         minute(datetime) == 0)

stopifnot(nrow(noaa_tide) == 144)   # 6 days x 24 hours

make_tidal_panel <- function(hab_data, tide_df = noaa_tide, pc1_col = "urchin_pc1",
                             model_label = "SVM", keep_dates = PLOT_DATES,
                             span = 0.45, smooth_tide = TRUE) {

  agg <- hab_data %>%
    filter(DATE %in% keep_dates) %>%
    group_by(TYPE, DATE, HOUR) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(.data[[pc1_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
              se    = sd(.data[[pc1_col]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop")

  # recorded hour range per date
  rec <- hab_data %>%
    filter(DATE %in% keep_dates) %>%
    group_by(DATE) %>%
    summarise(hmin = min(HOUR), hmax = max(HOUR), .groups = "drop")

  # tide trimmed to the recorded hours
  tide <- tide_df %>%
    mutate(DATE = as.Date(datetime, tz = SITE_TZ),
           HOUR = hour(datetime) + minute(datetime) / 60) %>%
    filter(DATE %in% keep_dates) %>%
    left_join(rec, by = "DATE") %>%
    filter(HOUR >= hmin, HOUR <= hmax + 1) %>%
    select(-hmin, -hmax)

  missing_dates <- setdiff(as.character(keep_dates), as.character(unique(tide$DATE)))
  if (length(missing_dates))
    warning("No tide data for: ", paste(missing_dates, collapse = ", "))

  tide_line <- if (smooth_tide) {
    tide %>%
      group_by(DATE) %>%
      group_modify(~ {
        s <- spline(.x$HOUR, .x$amplitude,
                    xout = seq(min(.x$HOUR), max(.x$HOUR), by = 1/6))
        tibble(HOUR = s$x, amplitude = s$y)
      }) %>%
      ungroup()
  } else tide

  base <- list(
    facet_grid(. ~ DATE, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x"),
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, 4)),
    theme_bw(base_size = 11),
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(r = 4)))
  )
  no_x     <- theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
  no_strip <- theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_blank())

  one_panel <- function(type, colour, ylab, drop_x, drop_strip) {
    p <- ggplot(filter(agg, TYPE == type), aes(HOUR, value)) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = value - se, ymax = value + se),
                    width = 0, colour = colour, alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_point(colour = colour, size = 1.4) +
      geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = span, se = FALSE,
                  colour = colour, linewidth = 0.9) +
      base + labs(x = NULL, y = ylab)
    if (drop_x)     p <- p + no_x
    if (drop_strip) p <- p + no_strip
    p
  }

  p_forest <- one_panel(FOREST_LABEL, "#00BFC4", "Forest PC1", TRUE,  FALSE)
  p_barren <- one_panel(BARREN_LABEL, "#F8766D", "Barren PC1", FALSE, TRUE) +
    labs(x = "Hour (Sitka local)")

  p_tide <- ggplot(tide_line, aes(HOUR, amplitude)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = tide, size = 0.7, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
    base + no_x + no_strip +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Tide (ft MLLW)")

  p_forest / p_tide / p_barren +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste0("Urchin acoustic activity, tidal cycle, and time of day (",
                     model_label, ")"),
      subtitle = "PC1 oriented so HIGHER = more urchin acoustics",
      caption = "Tide: NOAA harmonic predictions, Sitka station 9451600 (LST/LDT, MLLW)"
    )
}
```

```{r}
july_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(datetime_utc   = make_datetime(YY, MM, DD, hh, mm, tz = "UTC"),
         datetime_local = with_tz(datetime_utc, "America/Sitka"),
         WTMP   = if_else(WTMP >= 99, NA_real_, WTMP),
         WTMP_F = WTMP * 1.8 + 32) %>%
  filter(datetime_utc >= ymd_hms("2025-07-24 00:00:00", tz = "UTC"),
         datetime_utc <= ymd_hms("2025-07-28 23:59:59", tz = "UTC"))

wtmp_hourly <- july_data %>%
  mutate(DATE = as.Date(datetime_local, tz = SITE_TZ),
         HOUR = hour(datetime_local)) %>%
  group_by(DATE, HOUR) %>%
  summarise(wtmp_c = mean(WTMP, na.rm = TRUE),
            wtmp_f = mean(WTMP_F, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_obs  = sum(!is.na(WTMP)),
            .groups = "drop")


combined_df_extended <- combined_df %>%
  select(-any_of(c("WTMP_F", "wtmp_c", "wtmp_f", "n_obs",
                   "wtmp_c.x", "wtmp_f.x", "n_obs.x",
                   "wtmp_c.y", "wtmp_f.y", "n_obs.y"))) %>%
  left_join(wtmp_hourly, by = c("DATE", "HOUR"))

names(combined_df_extended)   # should have exactly one wtmp_c, wtmp_f, n_obs

combined_df_extended %>%
  summarise(n_missing_temp = sum(is.na(wtmp_c) | is.nan(wtmp_c)))

combined_df_extended %>% count(TYPE, site)   # expect 120 each
```

```{r}
# 1. Keep only complete rows once, so the PCA rows and the data rows are identical
combined_df_pca <- combined_df_extended %>%
  filter(complete.cases(tide, wtmp_f))

pca_data <- combined_df_pca %>%
  select(tide, wtmp_f)

# 2. PCA on standardized tide and temperature
tide_temp_pca <- prcomp(pca_data, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

summary(tide_temp_pca)     # variance explained by PC1
tide_temp_pca$rotation     # loadings: check PC1 sign and direction

# 3. Attach PC1 back to the table
combined_df_pca <- combined_df_pca %>%
  mutate(tide_temp_pc1 = tide_temp_pca$x[, "PC1"])

cor(pca_data$tide, pca_data$wtmp_f)
```

```{r}
               data = combined_df_pca,
```

```{r}
library(emmeans)
library(ggtext)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

# 1. Prediction grid from the new data --------------------------------------
pc_range <- range(combined_df_pca$tide_temp_pc1, na.rm = TRUE)
pc_vals  <- seq(pc_range[1], pc_range[2], length.out = 30)

elev_rng  <- range(combined_df_pca$elevation, na.rm = TRUE)
elev_vals <- seq(elev_rng[1], elev_rng[2], length.out = 5)   # replaces the hardcoded values

rg <- ref_grid(m_lme_pca_extended,
               data = combined_df_pca,
               at = list(tide_temp_pc1 = pc_vals,
                         elevation     = elev_vals))
preds <- as.data.frame(emmeans(rg, ~ tide_temp_pc1 * elevation * TYPE))

preds$elevation_lab <- factor(preds$elevation,
                              levels = elev_vals,
                              labels = paste0("Sun: ", round(elev_vals, 1), "\u00B0"))

# 2. Main emmeans plot -------------------------------------------------------
p_emmeans <- ggplot(preds, aes(x = tide_temp_pc1, y = emmean,
                               color = TYPE, fill = TYPE)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ elevation_lab, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-2, 0, 2),
    labels = c("-2\nCool", "0", "2\nWarm")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Habitat Type", values = hab_cols, labels = hab_labs) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Habitat Type", values = hab_cols, labels = hab_labs) +
  labs(x = "Tide/Temperature PC1<br><span style='font-size:10pt; color:grey40'>(high tide, cool \u2192 low tide, warm)</span>",
       y = "Predicted sea urchin activity PC1<br><span style='font-size:10pt; color:grey40'>(low noise \u2192 high noise)</span>") +
  theme_urchin() +
  theme(panel.spacing.x = unit(0.6, "lines"),
        axis.title.x = element_markdown(size = 12, lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(t = 8)),
        axis.title.y = element_markdown(size = 12, lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(r = 8)))

# 3. Solar-elevation gradient arrow -----------------------------------------
sun_stops <- c(-13.83, -12, -6, 0, 10, 30, 52.5)         # physical elevations for colours
sun_vals  <- rescale(sun_stops, from = elev_rng)
sun_vals[1] <- 0; sun_vals[length(sun_vals)] <- 1        # pin ends in case range differs slightly

sun_pal <- gradient_n_pal(
  colours = c("#050B24", "#1B2A6B", "#4B3F9E", "#E8604C",
              "#F7A93B", "#FFD84D", "#FFF3B0"),
  values = sun_vals
)
elev_to_col <- function(e) {
  sun_pal(rescale(pmin(pmax(e, elev_rng[1]), elev_rng[2]), from = elev_rng))
}
elev_to_x <- function(e) 0.1 + (e - elev_rng[1]) / diff(elev_rng) * 0.8

n <- 300
arrow_df <- data.frame(x = seq(0.01, 0.95, length.out = n))
arrow_df$elev <- elev_rng[1] + (arrow_df$x - 0.1) / 0.8 * diff(elev_rng)
arrow_df$col  <- elev_to_col(arrow_df$elev)
w <- diff(arrow_df$x[1:2])

head_df <- data.frame(x = c(0.95, 0.95, 1), y = c(0.1, 0.9, 0.5))
dots_df <- data.frame(x = elev_to_x(elev_vals), col = elev_to_col(elev_vals))

tick_df <- data.frame(elev = 0, lab = "Sunrise/Sunset")
tick_df$x <- elev_to_x(tick_df$elev)

p_arrow <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = arrow_df,
            aes(xmin = x, xmax = x + w * 1.05, ymin = 0.3, ymax = 0.7, fill = col)) +
  geom_polygon(data = head_df, aes(x, y), fill = elev_to_col(elev_rng[2])) +
  geom_segment(data = tick_df, aes(x = x, xend = x, y = 0.3, yend = 0.7),
               color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = tick_df, aes(x = x, y = 0.12, label = lab), size = 2.8) +
  geom_point(data = dots_df, aes(x, 0.5, fill = col),
             shape = 21, size = 4, color = "white", stroke = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 0.95, label = "Solar midnight",
           size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", vjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.9, y = 0.95, label = "Solar noon",
           size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", vjust = 0) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.4), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(8, 5.5, 0, 30))

# 4. Combine and save --------------------------------------------------------
p_final <- p_arrow / p_emmeans +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.16, 1))

p_final
ggsave("emmeans_tidetemp_type_elevation.png", p_final,
       width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 600)
```
